messages:
maria: Opening a small PR to make our tool-calling examples conform to the new structured-output envelope. PR #4891. Will update order-cancel, calendar-invite, and embeddings-re-rank snippets. Need docs + SDK helpers + link sweep.

rachel: Can you include a 1-line compatibility note for integrators that still expect the flat payload? That helps PMs and support.

maria: Yep. Draft compatibility note: 'New examples wrap results in an envelope (envelope.result). If you expect the old flat shape, read envelope.result; we'll keep a compatibility blurb in the migration guide.'

sam: I'll convert the calendar example (docs/examples/flows/calendar-invite.md). Also add a before/after fenced block in the PR description per style guide.

kevin: For SDKs I'll add tiny parse helpers (JS/Python) demonstrating a regex fallback and JSON Schema validation. I'll also add a one-line test in docs-tests to assert the example output validates.

docs-bot: Reminder: include before/after snippet diffs and update any duplicated examples. Redirects for old anchors should be filed separately.

maria: Added checklist in PR: schema file, updated examples, SDK helpers, tests, and redirect PR to follow. Assigning reviewers.

rachel: Thanks — I'll review after CI completes.

maria: Deployed preview available in the PR thread. Leaving notes for follow-up.
